features: Add required `model: string` field to `StageUsage` in `shared/types.ts` and propagate required `model` parameter through `UsageTracker.recordStage` abstract interface
Wire `config.resolvedModel*` values from all seven Claude call sites (planner, planner-revision, generator, evaluator, documenter, contract proposal, contract review) into `recordStage` invocations
Extend `UsageTracker.printSummary` per-stage breakdown with a left-aligned model column placed immediately after stage name, numeric columns remaining right-aligned
Add per-model rollup section to terminal summary: one row per distinct model, summing input tokens, output tokens, and total USD, sorted by total USD descending, always printed
Persist `model` field on every stage entry in `.adhd/usage.json`; load legacy entries without `model` as `model: "unknown"`; rewrite all entries in new shape on next `save()`
Update README.md, docs/INTERNALS.md, docs/ROADMAP.md, and CHANGELOG.md per Feature 6 rules
Add unit tests in `tests/` covering: model field storage, formatting helpers, rollup aggregator, legacy-load, and save/load round-trip; keep `bun run typecheck` and `bun run lint` green

criteria.name: stage_usage_model_field_stored_exactly
criteria.description: When `recordStage` is called with a model string (e.g. `"claude-sonnet-4-20250514"`), the resulting `StageUsage` entry in tracker state has `model` equal to that exact string — no truncation, no transformation.

criteria.name: record_stage_model_parameter_required
criteria.description: `bun run typecheck` exits zero only when every `recordStage` call site passes a `model` argument. Removing the argument from any call site must produce a TypeScript type error. The parameter must not be optional or defaulted in the abstract interface signature.

criteria.name: shared_has_zero_llm_sdk_imports
criteria.description: A grep of all files under `shared/` for LLM-SDK import strings (e.g. `@anthropic-ai/`, `@ai-sdk/`, `openai`) returns zero matches after this sprint's changes are applied.

criteria.name: call_site_model_routing_correct
criteria.description: In a run with `--model-planner=A --model-generator=B --model-evaluator=C --model-documenter=D`, the persisted `.adhd/usage.json` shows: planner and planner-revision stages have `model: "A"`, generator stage has `model: "B"`, evaluator stage has `model: "C"`, documenter stage has `model: "D"`, contract-proposal stage has `model: "B"`, contract-review stage has `model: "C"`.

criteria.name: per_stage_summary_includes_model_column
criteria.description: The per-stage formatting pure helper, when invoked with a sample `StageUsage[]` containing at least two distinct models, returns strings where each row contains the stage's `model` value as a left-aligned text column immediately after the stage name and before the numeric columns. Asserted directly on returned `string[]` without log capture.

criteria.name: per_model_rollup_aggregation_correct
criteria.description: The pure rollup aggregator, when given `StageUsage[]` where model `"X"` appears in three stages with (inputTokens: 100, outputTokens: 50, costUsd: 0.01), (200, 80, 0.02), (300, 120, 0.03), returns a `ModelRollupRow` for `"X"` with inputTokens=600, outputTokens=250, costUsd=0.06. Asserted directly on the returned struct.

criteria.name: per_model_rollup_sorted_by_usd_descending
criteria.description: When the rollup aggregator is given stages across three models with total USD of 0.05, 0.20, and 0.10, the returned `ModelRollupRow[]` is ordered: 0.20, 0.10, 0.05. The terminal summary renders them in this order.

criteria.name: rollup_always_printed_even_single_model
criteria.description: When a run uses only one model (no per-agent overrides), the terminal summary still prints the per-model rollup section with exactly one row containing that model's aggregated totals. The section header is always present.

criteria.name: legacy_usage_json_loads_without_throw
criteria.description: Given a `.adhd/usage.json` whose stage entries omit the `model` field entirely, loading it via the tracker does not throw. Every loaded `StageUsage` has `model === "unknown"`. A subsequent `save()` rewrites the file with `model: "unknown"` on all legacy entries and the new model string on any newly-recorded entries.

criteria.name: save_load_round_trip_preserves_model
criteria.description: A tracker that records stages with models `"alpha"`, `"beta"`, and `"gamma"`, calls `save()`, then is replaced by a fresh tracker instance that loads the same file: every stage's `model` in the loaded state equals the originally-recorded string. No model value is lost, coerced, or defaulted to `"unknown"`.

criteria.name: usage_json_key_order_consistent
criteria.description: Each stage object in a freshly-written `.adhd/usage.json` has keys in the order: `stage`, `model`, `inputTokens`, `outputTokens`, `cacheReadTokens`, `costUsd`, `durationMs`. Verified by reading the raw JSON string and checking key insertion order on at least one stage entry.

criteria.name: typecheck_and_lint_pass_clean
criteria.description: `bun run typecheck` and `bun run lint` (Biome) both exit with code 0 after all sprint changes. Zero new `any` casts are introduced in `shared/` or `harness-claude/` files touched by this sprint.

criteria.name: formatting_helpers_are_pure_and_directly_testable
criteria.description: The per-stage table formatter and the per-model rollup renderer are implemented as pure functions (or methods that return `string[]`) that can be imported and called in unit tests without spinning up a tracker, writing files, or capturing stdout. At least one unit test per helper asserts on the returned array directly.

criteria.name: code_quality_naming_dry_error_handling
criteria.description: All new identifiers in `shared/` and `harness-claude/` use consistent, descriptive names matching the domain vocabulary of the spec (`modelRollup`, `resolvedModel`, `StageUsage`, etc.). No copy-paste duplication exists between the per-stage formatter and the rollup formatter. Legacy-load defaulting to `"unknown"` is handled in exactly one place (the deserializer), not scattered across callers. Error handling for malformed JSON in `usage.json` produces a meaningful message (not a raw thrown parse error) and does not swallow the error silently.

criteria.name: documentation_files_updated_correctly
criteria.description: README.md contains updated Cost tracking paragraph and Observability bullet mentioning per-model attribution. docs/INTERNALS.md Cost Tracking section describes both summary views and the persisted `model` field. docs/ROADMAP.md Part 1 §1.11 bullet 3 is extended; Parts 2 and 3 contain no new per-model tracking entry. CHANGELOG.md contains a new `## Phase 1.6: Observability Sharpening` section with `### Sprint 1 -- Per-Model Usage Tracking` immediately after the Phase 1.5 block, using identical heading levels and Features→bullets→Verified line ordering.
